name: Merra
title: Grocer
examine: Brisk as a morning market. The traveler's cape on her wall is older than her shop, and cleaner than anything in it.
lines: Fresh eggs, yesterday's bread at half, and no credit. Except Nib. She eats free and pretends she doesn't.
My brother Tilo can carve a rose out of oak but can't finish a chair. Ask him about it and he'll tell you for an hour.
The cape on the wall was my Edwin's. The road kept him. I keep the cape.
